title: REPL and Sandbox Serialization
summary: This module provides tools for representing Python variables in a REPL-friendly format and defining how objects can be serialized for execution within sandboxed environments. It enables LLMs to interact with and manipulate complex data structures.

nodes.label: REPL Variable Metadata
nodes.title: REPL Variable Metadata
nodes.description: Defines a data structure to hold metadata about a variable in a REPL environment, including its name, type, description, constraints, total length, and a truncated preview. It's used to present variable information to LLMs or users.

nodes.label: Sandbox Serializable Interface
nodes.title: Sandbox Serializable Interface
nodes.description: An abstract base class for objects that need to be serialized and reconstructed within a sandboxed Python environment. It provides methods for environment setup, data serialization, code generation for variable assignment, and a brief preview for LLMs.

nodes.label: Pydantic Base Model
nodes.title: Pydantic Base Model
nodes.description: A base class from the Pydantic library for creating data models with type validation and serialization capabilities, ensuring data integrity and ease of use.

nodes.label: Python Abstract Base Class
nodes.title: Python Abstract Base Class
nodes.description: A module from Python's standard library for defining abstract base classes, which enforce that derived classes implement specific methods, ensuring a consistent interface.

nodes.label: Serialize to JSON-compatible
nodes.title: Serialize to JSON-compatible
nodes.description: A utility function that converts complex Python objects into a JSON-serializable format, enabling their representation as strings for display or storage, particularly for variable previews.

nodes.label: Build REPL Variable
nodes.title: Build REPL Variable
nodes.description: A utility function responsible for constructing a REPLVariable instance from a given Python value and optional Pydantic FieldInfo, facilitating the creation of variable metadata.

groups.label: Core REPL & Sandbox Components
groups.title: Core REPL & Sandbox Components
groups.description: The primary classes for managing REPL variable metadata and defining sandbox-serializable objects.

groups.label: Internal Utilities
groups.title: Internal Utilities
groups.description: Helper functions used internally by the core components for serialization and object construction.

groups.title: External Libraries
